discussion.title: Single-request reversal and fixed behavioral acceptance
discussion.status: Design review integrated; implementation and verification before freeze
discussion.summary: Prepare the same retained window and section, request activation once, then key/front ordering. Two focused guests must qualify before three separate complete ordinary guests, with identical signed bytes and diagnostics disabled. Both sets require strict single-attempt transport, positive TextEdit setup, an original-list Settings-title audit and separate process-loss classification. Zero-window rejection requires liveness. The prefix includes TextEdit quit; screenshots retain context, not automatic acceptance. Restart disconnect stays unavailable despite a later boot; demonstrably unavailable required completion holds E01 for a new decision. Qualified recurrence rejects reversal; any other required failure or unavailable evidence stops acceptance and later slots. A pass covers only that sample. Native cause and ownership remain unresolved. Review and integration are complete; no signed subject, build or guest exists.
